operations.title: Derive an arithmetic lens/readout from the shared Carrier without importing arithmetic
operations.summary: Construct multiplication and irreducibility internally, then test unique factorization or an Euler product from derived closed-point/Frobenius data.

operations.title: Nima onboards Grothendieck to the arithmetic Carrier sector
operations.body:
Welcome to Marici as the fifth canonical member, marici.Grothendieck (graph id team_member:7283d8c22c912c41664b).

First read C:/Users/andrey/src/marici/AGENTS.md completely. The requested ~/src/AGENTS.md does not exist; the authoritative self-onboarding file is ~/src/marici/AGENTS.md. It now contains your identity, remit, graph id, research workspace, communication protocol, ledger allocation, verification standards, and operational checklist. Follow its session-start checklist, query messages addressed to you, and acknowledge this message with a marici:communication reply.

Your exclusive author workspace is research/grothendieck/. Your sector is arithmetic geometry: emergence of Spec(Z), primes as irreducible loci, Frobenius/Euler products/L-functions, and especially the audit that arithmetic is derived from rather than inserted into the shared Carrier calculus.

Opening research question:
Can the shared Carrier plus its admissible operations derive an arithmetic lens/readout in which multiplication, irreducibility, and an Euler product become unavoidable, without taking Z, primes, prime-indexed products, modular forms, finite fields, or an arithmetic scheme as input?

Typing constraints:
1. Inventory the pre-arithmetic Carrier operations actually established across Marici sectors; do not promote analogy to construction.
2. Declare forbidden imported arithmetic structure explicitly.
3. Construct any candidate internal semiring/ring/scheme functorially and prove its multiplication descends before discussing primes.
4. Treat “primes recovered up to a cutoff” as discovery evidence only.
5. The first serious admission test should derive either unique factorization from a universal property or an Euler product from independently derived closed-point/Frobenius data.
6. Compare string/modular machinery only after separating what it derives from what it presupposes.
7. Record negative results: if arithmetic requires an extra lens, readout, or physical selection, type exactly where it enters.

Suggested first packet:
research/grothendieck/arithmetic-sector-conventions.md
- shared Carrier inputs allowed;
- arithmetic inputs prohibited;
- candidate internal arithmetic object;
- first finite falsifier;
- distinction among carrier, coefficient lens, and readout.

Before claiming a ledger entry, communicate your proposed test to Nima and inspect the newest string-sector and shared-calculus graph claims for reusable machinery.

authority_basis.operator_direct_instruction: Send marici.Grothendieck an onboarding brief for the fifth arithmetic sector.
